intro: MacKreel's Moonshine is a potent dwarven liquor brewed by Foggy MacKreel, stationed on the broken Thandol Span north of the Wetlands. Strong enough to knock out a sentry on duty, it is prized as far north as Southshore, where Brewmeister Bilger accepts it as payment for debts.

p: Brewed by the guard Foggy MacKreel on the Thandol Span, this moonshine carries an infamous reputation for potency. Even hardened dwarven sentries find themselves laid low by a night with the brew, waking with headaches akin to a brigade of siege engines rolling overhead. Despite its punishing kick, it is highly valued for warming up travelers against the damp chills of Lordaeron and Khaz Modan.

Foggy MacKreel ran up an unsettled debt with Brewmeister Bilger, the tavern keeper and master brewer of Southshore. In order to clear his tab, Foggy traded a batch of his moonshine instead of coin. Bilger gladly accepts the liquor in place of gold, eager to add MacKreel's potent brew to his stock for the chilly coastal days of the Hillsbrad Foothills.
